title: Integrator (Discrete or Continuous)
text: 离散时间或连续时间积分器，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {External reset} 指定重置策略；{Integrator method} 用于指定积分或累加方法的选项 Integration: Forward、{Limit type} 指定饱和策略 Anti-windup、{Upper saturation limit} 指定状态上限 inf、{Lower saturation limit} 指定状态下限 -inf、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: 用于指定积分或累加方法的选项 Integration: Forward Euler (default) | Integration: Backward Euler | Integration: Trapezoidal | Accumulation: Forward Euler | Accumulation: Backward Euler | Accumulation: Trapezoidal

params.name: External reset
params.values: 重置策略 level (default) | rising | falling | either

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: 状态上限 inf (default) | real number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
